In this video we cover:
Adani Green Q4 Results & India's Renewable Energy Boom Explained
Adani Green Energy ne Q4 mein 59% profit growth dikhaya, aur 2030 tak 50 GW capacity ka ambitious plan announce kiya. Is video mein AGEL ke results, segment-wise performance, aur India ke renewable energy trends aur challenges ka breakdown milega. Discover how AGEL is competing with Tata Power, JSW, Reliance, and NTPC in the race for clean energy leadership.
